# Vendored geography

Generated by `python3 -m dcatlas vendor --download-dir <tmp>` from Natural Earth v5.1.2
1:50m admin-0 countries and admin-1 boundary lines (public domain), downloaded from the pinned
tag of `nvkelso/natural-earth-vector` and checked against the SHA-256 values in
`dcatlas/geo.py`. `basemap.json` holds Equal Earth-projected SVG paths for the site map;
`countries.json` holds simplified polygons used to assign countries to OpenStreetMap features.
